outcomeDiff: Delivered exactly the expected outcome plus one widening found by review: reviewer finding F-001 showed the coverage derivation missed join-shape writes, so review-loops.jsonl was also registered and the invariant gained a second derivation pass with scoped identifier resolution (F-002 hardened). The count moved from four registered filenames to five, and the derivation from one pass to two; no promised behavior was reduced.
limitations: The coverage derivation reads store.ts source text; writes to story dirs from other modules (e.g. background.md from handlers/story-create.ts) are outside its stated derivation domain, though such filenames are already registered. The brace-depth walker does not mask string/comment content when ascending multiple block levels; its failure direction is a loud spurious divergence, never silent acceptance (F-003 dismissal rationale).
pitfalls: When adding a new StoryStore top-level artifact write, register the filename in LATTICE_LIFECYCLE_ARTIFACT_FILENAMES in the same commit or the lifecycle-registry consistency contract fails validate with a named divergence. The single exemption authority-receipt-refs.json must be removed from STORYSTORE_TOP_LEVEL_FILENAME_EXEMPTIONS when the Authority capability work makes its write path live.
